messages:
Alex (CEO): quick heads-up for the week — three short priorities and a small policy note. TL;DR: stabilize Private GA, push cost-per-token optimizations, and tighten data-retention defaults. :rocket:

Alex (CEO): priorities:
• Private GA: finish compliance checklist + customer pilot rollouts (target: Wed EOD). @Jordan pls confirm pilot list.
• Cost: hit an incremental -12% unit cost by end of week through batching and pruning cold models. current: -8% vs baseline. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
• Reliability: SLO 99.95% for inference p50/p95. We had a small spike yesterday at 03:12 UTC — root cause: a KV cache eviction bug, patch landing now.

Alex (CEO): policy note — default data retention for hosted logs will move from 90 -> 30 days for new orgs starting next Tuesday; existing customers unaffected unless they opt in. This is to reduce storage costs and simplify compliance. cc @Priya

Jordan - VP Product: ack — will lock pilot list by tomorrow morning. quick q: do we want to deprioritize any non-core features this sprint to free eng cycles?

Sam (VP Eng): we can reprioritize. current canary for private-ga infra is green on 2/3 clusters, one failing due to gc config. rollback plan ready.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary deploy report: private-ga/v1.4 — cluster-a: ✅, cluster-b: ✅, cluster-c: ❌ (OOM during KV rebuild). See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4765

Marie - Head of Ops: noted on capacity — Dedicated pools have 5% buffer but if pilots scale we should pre-warm another node group. tagging infra and releng. @Sam can you action pre-warm?

Sam (VP Eng): will pre-warm 2 g4dn groups by noon. Also landing hotfix for KV eviction in 10m.

Taylor (CFO): cost note: good progress on -8%. To hit -12% we need both batching config changes and to enable L7 quantization on low-priority models. Approving short-term infra spend for pre-warm.

Priya (People Ops): hiring update: temporary hold on non-critical IC reqs through the quarter; exceptions require VP sign-off. Also sending a heads-up about two exec-level recruiter interviews next week.

Alex (CEO): thanks all. small ask: each VP to post a 1-line status update here by EOD Thu with measurable next-step (e.g., "Private GA: pilots locked, canaries pass on 3 clusters").

Jordan - VP Product: will post 1-liner by EOD Thu.

Sam (VP Eng): 1-liner: KV eviction hotfix merged, canary C failing -> pre-warm + hotfix should clear by 12:30 UTC.

Marie - Head of Ops: 1-liner: pre-warm scheduled, monitoring dashboards updated, ops runbook v2 published (link in #docs).

Taylor (CFO): 1-liner: approved pre-warm spend, tracking cost delta in weekly finances deck.

Priya (People Ops): 1-liner: hiring hold in place, emergency exceptions process sent to VPs.

Sam (VP Eng): rollback command if needed:
```
# rollback canary
./deploy rollback private-ga --to v1.3 --clusters cluster-c
```

Alex (CEO): appreciate the quick alignment. small morale note: thank the pilots team if you see them — they're doing heavy lifting. :raised_hands:
